name: Split adjustable capacitor
summary: This representation distinguishes the publisher's split and adjustable capacitor form.
description: This representation distinguishes the publisher's split and adjustable capacitor form. More than one capacitive section belongs to the publisher’s split adjustable form. The section/common relationships and the coordinated adjustment are part of the circuit interpretation.
Keep separate section connections visible where they serve different circuit paths. The educational preview is not a substitute for the selected component’s terminal arrangement.
